# visualizations abot student behavior


```{r}
# class year usage
class_year = tutoring |>
  filter(!is.na(Class_Year_Code)) |>
  group_by(Class_Year_Code)|>
  summarise(total_requests = n())|>
  arrange(Class_Year_Code)

ggplot(class_year, aes(x=class_year, y=total_requests))+
  geom_segment(aes(x = class_year, xend = Class_Year_Code, y = 0, yend = total_requests), color = "blue")+
  geom_point(size = 4, color = "green")+
  labs(
    title = "Tutoring Requests by Student Class Year",
    x = "Class Year Code",
    y = "Number of Requests")+
  theme_minimal()
```
